description: A file ages past its TTL budget while unreachable (a NEW stale_over_budget_unreachable key, current\baseline regression) but the code is advisory-until-infra BY DESIGN (ADR-0555): its keys enter by TIME passing, not by PR action, so admission-blocking would blame PRs for age accrued on other clocks. The firewall REPORTS the regression count but does NOT fail the verdict — the convergence surface is the staleness-reaper reconciler (report -> git mv -> _archive/). NOTE: the exists-but-unaccounted classes (unowned/unreachable/no_ttl_class/untyped_staleness) were converted to baseline-block-on-new by ADR-0555 and are pinned RED by tc-FW-bad-new-unowned-file-blocked / tc-FW-bad-new-unreachable-file-blocked.
